Founded in 1968, Phoenix Fabrikations has been at the forefront of the European nonwoven industry, establishing itself as a trusted partner in the world of nonwoven fabrics. We are proud of our enduring relationships with leading producers in the nonwoven sector, which is a testament to our commitment and reliability. Legacy of excellence Phoenix Fabrikations specializes in the distribution of nonwoven rolls and stocklots. Our knowledge of nonwovens and the nonwoven industry benefits both our suppliers and our customers. We strive to always offer the best service and proactively help our customers find the most suitable nonwovens for their needs. We also offer converting services to meet the requirements of our customers. We can, for example, slit rolls into the required roll width. A wide range of nonwoven rolls and stocklots Our commitment to being a trusted partner in the nonwoven industry for over five decades is reflected in the diversity of our product range based on various Nonwoven technologies. We can offer, for example, hydroentangeled Spunlace, Microfilament, Airlaid Paper, Drylaid Card & Bind fabrics. The various qualities are available on rolls and/or bales. We serve the following markets: Medical Our medical-grade nonwoven rolls and stocklots find their way to various applications in the medical sector. Our fabrics are being used for disposable swabs or compresses, disposable visiting gowns and caps or surgery sheets and drapes. But they also serve intensive cleaning applications, from patient wipes to cleaning operating rooms. Hygiene As a long-term supplier to the hygiene industry we fully understand the requirements to follow. Our spunlace nonwovens for example are being used for the production of impregnated wet wipes, such as baby wipes or cosmetic wipes. Our latex and multibonded airlaid offers an absorbent core to feminine and baby hygiene care products. Industrial wiping Phoenix Fabrikations was one of the first to introduce nonwoven wipes and rags into industrial cleaning environments. Nowadays, our nonwoven fabrics find extensive application in industrial wiping . They are specially engineered to meet the highest wiping qualities, ensuring maximum efficiency in your operations. Specialty: Microfilament nonwoven Our microfilament nonwoven , M-Z, is the ultimate solution for the professional cleaning market. The microfilaments capture even the tiniest particles of dirt ensuring a clean and streak-free finish. M-Z is washable and re-usable for more than 100 times which enables you to actively contribute to reducing waste and minimizing your carbon footprint. Why choose Phoenix Fabrikations Decades of experience: With over half a century of experience, we bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise to every transaction. Wide range of nonwovens: Phoenix offers a wide range of nonwoven rolls and stocklots serving various markets and needs. Competitive pricing: We always strive to provide our customers with the most competitive prices for our nonwoven rolls and stocklots. Reliability: Our long-term relationships with top producers in the nonwoven industry testify to our reliability as a partner. Let’s meet! We would be pleased to help you find the ideal nonwoven fabric for your requirements and join our extensive and satisfied customer base!
